# Validate byte-string range before narrowing into a Uint8Array

The current byteStringToUint8Array contract expects a ByteString. It stores each character code in a Uint8Array. The RNP import caller then checks arr.some(c => c > 255), which cannot detect an original code unit outside the byte range after narrowing. A focused Node probe of the exact accepted utility converted code unit 256 to byte 0 and the later test returned false. Manual boundary proposal: if a caller accepts arbitrary Unicode text, reject or encode it before narrowing; do not use a post-conversion range check as proof that the input was 8-bit. This is a confirmed representation limit, not a reproduced crypto failure or exploit.

Scope: mail/string-byte-boundary.
